text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Inari One and Tamamo Cross suffered 
defeat. Tamamo Cross resolved never to 
lose again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's heart was struck by that 
desperate hunger for victory. She vowed 
that next year's Takarazuka Kinen would be 
hers to win.
